# Aged PU foam compression tests (ASTM D1621)

`1BAT-DIR1-1.TRA` (one test of batch 1, direction 1) and `1BAT-DIM.txt`
(that batch's specimen dimensions in mm, ten rows of three; the archive
does not say which column is the height) are from:

> Pires da Silva, E. H. (2023). *Aged PUF compression tests* (version 3).
> Mendeley Data. https://doi.org/10.17632/2sp8fyvhfm.3

Licence: [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/) (read
on the Mendeley Data record, 2026-11-13). Unchanged; SHA-256 as listed by
Mendeley Data: `1BAT-DIR1-1.TRA` 2403e87713625dfba70fe6c28e87ddbc33a2d68f9666ea4c08383dd04c50eb47,
`1BAT-DIM.txt` 406ad865a060e7194caa305a85a1d71cc3f9beb277982f2f07498539cd1620ea.

The dataset publishes no evaluated results, so these files check that
TenForge reads the export (French names in quotes, a units row) and that
the ISO 844 profile runs on real data; they are compared with nothing.
